blocks.orig: The Mange Sandbank lies in the south of the Mafia Archipelago and is the most pristine patch of pure, white sand set in the bluest ocean. Exposed only on low tide, it’s surrounded by tropical reefs teaming with colourful corals and fish. To reach the sandbank, you first sail an hour and a half over the Indian Ocean, after which you can scuba or snorkel over the Mange Reefs. On the sandbank, a Swahili fish barbecue will be served. The perfect barefoot luxury experience!
blocks.html: In the south of the Mafia Archipelago you will find the Mange Sandbank, the most untouched stretch of pure white sand surrounded by the bluest ocean. It’s only exposed at low tide, and around it lie tropical reefs teeming with colourful corals and fish. Getting there involves an hour and a half of sailing across the Indian Ocean, after which you can scuba dive or snorkel above the Mange Reefs. You are served a Swahili fish barbecue on the sandbank itself. Barefoot luxury at its best!

blocks.orig: Only possible on low tide and with good weather
blocks.html: Can only go ahead at low tide and in good weather
